units: metres, seconds, radians unless the key says _deg or _steps

clutch_model.source: BrickSim@76815250 native/modules/bricksim/physx/assembly.cppm (AssemblyThresholds) as set by RoCo config/system_config.json

breakage.source: BrickSim@76815250 native/modules/bricksim/physx/breakage.cppm BreakageThresholds defaults; RoCo does not override them

postconditions.source: chosen for this evaluator; not calibrated against real bricks

probe.note: upward force of weight_ratio x the brick's own weight (physics:mass authored by BrickSim) for `steps` physics steps after release, retreat and settling; the largest rise over steps+observe_steps is compared with lift_tol_m. An unwelded brick rises ~10 mm and falls back; a welded one does not move.

baseline.policy: privileged waypoint FSM derived from rocobrick.policy.NaivePolicy (MIT); exact brick poses from the simulator; goal_fsm picks the arm and the symmetric goal turn by IK residual and re-aims the place waypoints with the brick's measured pose in the gripper
baseline.press_depth_note: RoCo NaivePolicy presses 0.12 u (1.15 mm) past the seat; with the in-hand pose corrected that peaked at 0.86 N, below BrickSim's 1 N trigger (it only worked uncorrected because the brick sags ~0.8 mm in the gripper)
baseline.stop_on_engagement_note: goal_fsm stops the press at the first BrickSim 'assembled' event for the placed brick (privileged engine signal; press_depth_units is then only the travel limit). Without it the arm keeps pushing the already welded structure 2.9 mm into the table and PhysX pushes the free baseplate sideways.

randomization.note: v1 uses no physics randomization; seeds only drive numpy/random and the storage arrangement order
